summary: Build a foundation in ISO 9001:2026 QMS requirements and prepare for the PECB Foundation exam in this two-day course.
audienceIntro: This ISO 9001:2026 Foundation course is designed for people who support a QMS or need a clear entry-level grounding in quality management requirements. It is relevant to quality staff, process owners, and professionals who contribute to customer satisfaction and continual improvement.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. The PECB Certificate Holder in ISO 9001:2026 Foundation credential requires completion of the training course, passing the exam, applying for the certificate, and signing the PECB Code of Ethics. Professional experience, QMS audit or assessment experience, and QMS project experience are not required.
